moments.C1E1M01: The bell tower across the water lights teal while you stand on the pier, and the first Tollbearer turns round.
moments.C1E1M02: The closets in the customs hall open behind you when you take the key off the desk.
moments.C1E1M03: The north hoist drops Gaunts between the stalls while Bellhands toll from the gallery.
moments.C1E1M04: You wade down into the flooded cellars with the lights going out behind you.
moments.C1E1M05: The switchback terraces, shot at from above, with the funicular car the way to cheat the climb.
moments.C1E1M06: The first Warden-Graft lowers its shoulder across the open ferry hall.
moments.C1E1M07: The power is out: three fuses, the radio in the dark, and the Signal House lit again when you throw it.
moments.C1E1M08: You cut the Cantor's ring of bells and it staggers, then the tower sings back.
moments.C1E2M01: The gatehouse is taken from the open, then the way round it opens behind them.
moments.C1E2M02: The flats: nothing to hide behind, the Hush on the wind, and the harpoon in your hands for the first time.
moments.C1E2M03: Crossing the yard between moving wagons under fire.
moments.C1E2M04: A run along the kiln mouths while they breathe out.
moments.C1E2M05: The first cradle with a person in it, and then the room wakes.
moments.C1E2M06: The catwalks of the pump hall, with the drop under you and the Gills at your height.
moments.C1E2M07: The lights die in the undercroft and the flare is the only one you have.
moments.C1E2M08: The Graft-Mother with her feeders fed: starve them or she heals.
moments.C1E3M01: The crater's rim: crossfire from the hull, and the first Chorister's shots opening your cone.
moments.C1E3M02: The ship breathes in, the gate opens, and you have four seconds.
moments.C1E3M03: The spores bloom on a clock while snipers hold the ledges above the beds.
moments.C1E3M04: The Weeping Mother on her dais, two Bulwarks at her stairs, under the ash sky.
moments.C1E3M05: The sound-lock will not open while you are loud, and the platforms over the pit keep their own time.
moments.C1E3M06: A raked wedge of pews and singers: you advance a tier at a time.
moments.C1E3M07: Four vats on a ring round the furnace, each dropping more until you kill it.
moments.C1E3M08: The Grand Cantor's double ring, in the bell of its own throat.
moments.C1E4M01: Containers fall past you on the tether, and the sky is all around.
moments.C1E4M02: Thrown from hulk to hulk over nothing.
moments.C1E4M03: The lock is cycling, the air is leaving, and they are on your side of it.
moments.C1E4M04: You turn a mirror a quarter and the beam finds the receiver across the array.
moments.C1E4M05: The fruit of the tree is a key, and taking it wakes the pods.
moments.C1E4M06: The whole elite roster, rank by rank, up the Gate's marble.
moments.C1E4M07: Four landings up a drum over a white ring of light, a lever on each.
moments.C1E4M08: You turn the Warden's own beam on its seals, and the Gate opens anyway.
moments.C2M01: You step off a black beach under the other sky.
moments.C2M02: A plain of glass, and a long way to the next thing you can hide behind.
moments.C2M03: Taking the outpost's wall from the fork field.
moments.C2M04: The forks answer any shot you fire: you choose where the Tollbearers go.
moments.C2M05: The road through the reliquary, the graves opening either side.
moments.C2M06: Upstream against the current with the shooters on the banks.
moments.C2M07: The yard makes more until you stop it.
moments.C2M08: The last climb out of the Threshold with the sky opening.
moments.C2M09: The lantern goes on and a city is there.
moments.C2M10: A market of peaceful Vael, and the first shot sends them running.
moments.C2M11: Two gates and one choice, and the next map remembers.
moments.C2M12: The flooded choir singing under the water you stand in.
moments.C2M13: Oil running low in a maze of bones, with things that hunt by light.
moments.C2M14: Play the chime's phrase back in the dark and the gate opens.
moments.C2M15: The basilica's elites in their ash.
moments.C2M16: The Sub-Cantor's ring comes back off the wall behind you.
moments.C2M17: The Hive's beat under the long approach, the singers keeping time.
moments.C2M18: Walking the lattice over the drop, three valves to turn and the nerve lit under you.
moments.C2M19: Loom gates on the beat: go on the off-beat or wait.
moments.C2M20: Riding the car through the veins while they come along the track.
moments.C2M21: A skiff across the foundry's pit, and the wheel turning over it.
moments.C2M22: Halls with nothing in them, and then a little.
moments.C2M23: Marrow Quay again, mirrored and wrong.
moments.C2M24: Kill the choir and only then can you hurt the Hive Cantor.
moments.C2M25: Six landings down the well, each thrown from the last.
moments.C2M26: Sleepers everywhere: how loud you are is on the screen, and it is up to you when it breaks.
moments.C2M27: The fault opens under the road behind you as you run the lip.
moments.C2M28: Nine strokes of the bell, and the tide coming in between them.
moments.C2M29: The clapper falls, and you stand inside the bell with it.
moments.C2M30: Light the lamp at the Gate.
